description: Enter what you're lending and who borrowed it. See all your active loans below.

props.text: Enter what you're lending and who borrowed it. See all your active loans below.
Text input field labeled 'Item Name' for entering the name of the item being lent
Text input field labeled 'Borrower Name' for entering the name of the person borrowing the item
Button labeled 'Save' that triggers creation of a new loan record when clicked
Vertical scrollable list displaying all saved loan records with item name and borrower name, ordered newest first
Error message display area that shows validation errors when save fails due to empty or whitespace-only fields
